title: Guiding idea
slide_intent: Teach readers to find the shared idea beneath different accounts of achievement. Three simple illustrations let the relationship travel across language and context.
strategic_value: Special Olympics can give local storytellers a common point of reference as they choose their own words.
demonstration: Three illustrated ideas surround a red triangular field holding the white symbol. A dotted line connects that field to a smaller overlap diagram.
practical_value: Use the three ideas to test whether a local story expresses discovery, achievement and participation together.

content_islands.name: Explanation
content_islands.spec: Place the key idea and supporting text in a narrow column at left.

content_islands.name: Relationship diagram
content_islands.spec: Connect the small overlap diagram to the enlarged red field. Put the central symbol inside and arrange the three illustrations around the vertices.
